title: Managing Prison Inmates with Dementia and Supporting Their Re-integration into Society
what_it_is: Managing Prison Inmates with Dementia and Supporting Their Re-integration into Society

sections.label: Dementia care for inmates
sections.summary: SPS calibrates support to each inmate's needs, with specialist care at the Institute of Mental Health and Changi General Hospital, and housing at the Complex Medical Centre if close monitoring is needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, they may find it difficult to remember events, communicate with others and carry out daily tasks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) calibrates the support for each inmate based on their individual needs, including the severity of their dementia.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They receive specialist outpatient medical care for their dementia at the Institute of Mental Health and Changi General Hospital, and undergo regular follow-ups as required.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They will be housed at the Complex Medical Centre of the prison if they require close monitoring by medical staff.

sections.label: Nursing home referrals after release
sections.summary: Inmates with dementia lacking family support and needing long-term residential care can be referred to nursing homes or welfare homes through the Agency for Integrated Care upon release.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Inmates with dementia who lack family support and require long-term residential care can be referred to nursing homes or welfare homes through the Agency for Integrated Care, upon their release.

sections.label: Three inmates with dementia
sections.summary: Three inmates in SPS custody are diagnosed with dementia, and SPS works with the medical centre and Changi General Hospital on their needs and assessments.

sentences.text: Currently, there are three inmates in SPS' custody who are diagnosed with dementia.
We look after them, we work with the medical centre and also Changi General Hospital to see what their needs are.

So, I want to assure the Member that we will continue to look at it, take care of them and at the same time, making sure that all of them have the opportunity to go through the programmes that are open to the inmates.
And from time to time, we do the assessment.
